title: Research Snacks: chronological All, subjects, topics and search
status: Chosen B revision built for feature-preview review
purpose: Choose a relevant public claim check from its question and finding.
user: A field expert arriving from a shared link, returning from RSS, or looking for linguistics or economic history. No AI background or previous author posts assumed.

today.heading: Chosen revision
today.text: The owner chose B with a chronological All list, a tag cloud and a more prominent search box. The complete All list replaces the repeated latest-three strip. Topic counts match the existing linked tag pages. A phone expands Topics on demand. Production remains unchanged.

commitments.text: Keep the cream compact publication, one header and all entry URLs; change the front page only.
Offer questions, findings and subjects with counts; make newest work and RSS easy to find.
Existing search and entry contents remain; no production publication before a preview and approval.

journey.step: Choose from all checks, newest first
Narrow by subject, use a tag and return
Search with a phrase and read a result
Return for new work or subscribe
